newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soymeal ends mostly higher as soybeans rally.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soymeal ends mostly higher as soybeans rally.

text.p: CBOT soymeal futures closed mostly higher on a rally in soybeans tied to forecasts for frost this week in northern portions of the U.S. Midwest soybean growing region, traders said.
Meteorologists early Monday said two cold fronts would move through the Midwest this week and aggressive selling interest in the soy complex evaporated, they said.
Soymeal also found support from bullish input from Friday's USDA cattle on feed report which showed August placements at 19 percent above a year ago, at the high end of expectations.
Soymeal closed $1.80 per ton higher to $1.20 lower, with October up $1.80 at $260.80. Soyoil was 0.07 to 0.29 cent per lb lower, with October down 0.07 at 25.18.
Soymeal futures volume was estimated at 16,000 contracts, down from 20,205 Friday, according to the CBOT. Soyoil futures volume was estimated at 10,000 contracts, down from 11,118 Friday.
